page.layout: One printed page with one text column. Heading "PRAEFATIO." at the top. Below it, one running block of text with an indented verse couplet at the end. Catchword "Cum" at the bottom right. Signature mark at the bottom left. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: PRAEFATIO.
main_text.p: Ioannes Champion præbendarius de Vual-tam duas meretrices habuit, Guilhelmus Crosse maritatam unam, Thomas Parcker duas solutas, Ricardus Busselde solutam u-nam, de qua suscitauit sobolem: Bartholo-mæus Cokisley solutam unam, Robertus Hunt plures: Thomas Gosse duas coniuga-tas, Ioannes Hylle tredecim meretrices, Ro-bertus More plures, Rogerus Barham plu-res, Ioannes Bedselde plures, & alij alias: in-ter quos etiam prædicti Rogerus Barham & Ioannes Champion reperti sunt Sodomi-tæ. Hæc ex prædicto libro. Vide qualia por-tenta in monasterijs & collegijs, & in suo co-libatu, Papatus per Angliam nutriuit. Nónnę[?] merito sunt pulsi, cum fordidissimo Roma-nensium omnium idolo Papa? In alijs quoq; omnibus, tam collegijs quàm conuentibus, similia sunt perpetrata ac reperta, quæ per-longum esset per omnia referre, imò turpis-simum: contracta simul, ob eandem Papæ reli-gionem, multis in locis, scabie Gallica, uel morbo Hispanico. Quoniam erant in Anglia plus q quadringenta diuersi generis mona-chorum & monialium cœnobia, præter fratrum Mendicatium sceleratissimos nidos, quorum etiam fuerunt ferè duceta. Quibus aptissimè conuenit hoc distichon:

p.i: Non male sunt Monachis grata indita nomina patrum,

page.notes: Heading "PRAEFATIO." is the title of the preface and is set as a level-1 head. No running head or page number is printed. Words marked [?]: "Nónnę" (last letter uncertain). The long-s forms in "Crosse", "Gosse", "Busselde", "Bedselde" and "suscitauit" are read as plain s per the rules, though the scan shows ligature-like ff/f forms, so these readings are inferred. The second line of the couplet is not printed on this page; only "patrum," appears, and it is kept as printed. Signature mark at the bottom left is hard to read.
